subject: Decision Making
subcategory: Famous Decisions That Changed the World
title: Crick and Watson Race for DNA
description: Learn Crick and Watson Race for DNA in one minute.

hook.text: Crick and Watson decided to build physical models of DNA while their rival Rosalind Franklin used X-ray data.

buildup.text: Their first model was wrong. Franklin pointed out the errors publicly. They went back and rebuilt.

discovery.text: They realized DNA was a double helix. The structure immediately explained how genetic information is copied.

twist.text: They used Franklin's X-ray photo without her knowledge or credit. The discovery was brilliant. The ethics were not.

climax.text: Speed won the race. But cutting ethical corners on credit created a controversy that outlived the discovery.

punchline.text: Right answer, wrong method. Speed and ethics do not always align.

quiz.question: What ethical failure marred the DNA discovery?
options: They used Rosalind Franklin's data without her knowledge or credit
